description: Election Commission - A. M. Senavirathna Banda was Selected as the Member of the Padaviya Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of a local government body (Padaviya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the electoral process for selecting a new member after a seat became vacant, which falls under the category of electoral processes and related matters.
